slides.copy:
Mushrooms don't
compete for space.
They trade for it.

Beneath every forest
is a network older
than the trees.

slides.title:
Share of forest carbon routed
through fungal networks

slides.copy:
A single teaspoon
of soil holds miles
of living thread.

Trees pay the
network in sugar.

The network answers
in nitrogen, water,
and warning signals.

Cut one tree
and the whole
grid feels it.

Intelligence, it turns out,
doesn't need a brain.
Just a network.
